subject: Quick follow-up: any feedback on fit with Redwood Inference?
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Clarke <emily.clarke@novapay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap & proposed next steps

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call so you have everything in one place and a proposed way forward: 

Key pain you mentioned:
- Spike in inference cost during end-of-month reporting windows (50–70% token increase)
- Latency/service variability when peaks align with other batch jobs

Success metrics you care about:
- 95th percentile inference latency < 150ms for 1k rps bursts
- 30% reduction in per-token cost for inference pipelines
- Auditability for data retention + SOC2 evidence for the payments data path

What we proposed:
- Short pilot: 2-week evaluation using Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) for your reconciliation pipeline
- Instrumentation: token-level cost breakdown + per-route dashboards in Redwood Console
- Safety/compliance: private VPC option + audit log export for SOC2 scope

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (call notes), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (MVP scope + timeline)

Proposed next step: 15–30 minute technical sync with your infra lead to scope the pilot (I’m available Wed/Thu next week). If that feels big, a 15-min decision call to confirm priority also works.

If this isn’t the right time, could you tell me if this is: 
- a) high priority (we should schedule pilot)
- b) on the roadmap but >6 months out
- c) not a fit for NovaPay right now

Appreciate any quick signal either way — saves both our teams time.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Clarke <emily.clarke@novapay.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & proposed next steps

Emily —

Following up on the note below and the MAP I shared. I know budgets and timelines shift — wanted to check whether you had a chance to look and if you could share a quick signal on fit.

If helpful, I can drop a single-slide ROI estimate for your reconciliation workflow (very light) or lock in a 15-minute slot for next week to run through requirements.

Best,
Priyom

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Clarke <emily.clarke@novapay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & proposed next steps

Hi Emily —

Final quick nudge on this thread — I don’t want to clutter your inbox. If you have two minutes, could you reply with one of the options below so we can either move forward or close the loop: 

1) Yes — this is worth a short pilot. Please intro me to the infra/ops owner and I’ll handle scheduling.
2) Maybe later — we should revisit in Q2; would you mind sharing the earliest window?
3) Not a fit — a one-line reason would be super helpful for our product feedback (e.g., "already covered by internal infra", "timing", "budget").

If it helps, Ben (cc’d) can provide a quick breakdown of expected per-token savings for a typical reconciliation job — happy to share the math.
